cardOverview.overviewText: The PNB EMT credit card from Punjab National Bank is a specialized co-branded card designed for students and travelers, offering tailored rewards and benefits suited for education-related expenses and international transactions.

benefitRows.name: EMT
benefitRows.offer: Flat 10% off Upto Rs. 1,000 on domestic flight bookings, No (Minimum order value)|Flat 10% off Upto Rs. 5,000 on international flight bookings, No (Minimum order value)|Flat 20% discount Up to Rs.5,000 on domestic hotel bookings, No (Minimum order value)|Flat 20% discount Up to Rs.10,000 on international hotel bookings, No (Minimum order value)|Flat Rs.125 off on bus bookings on minimum order value of Rs.500|Discount will be applicable up to 4 transactions per card in a month.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Insurance Coverage upto Rs. 2 Lacs for Accidental Death and Personal Total Disability
